source_registry.title: The EU AI Act's phased entry into force (2024-2027)

chunks.content: The EU AI Act — the world's first comprehensive AI law — was published in the EU Official Journal on 2024-07-12 and entered into force on 2024-08-01. Its obligations are phased: prohibited practices ("unacceptable risk") apply from 2025-02-02; general-purpose AI (GPAI) model obligations from 2025-08-02; high-risk system obligations from 2026-08-02, with a subset applying from 2027-08-02. The risk tiers are unacceptable (banned outright — social scoring, certain manipulative or exploitation-of-vulnerability uses), high, limited (transparency duties), and minimal, plus the separate GPAI model category with duties scaled by systemic-risk status (the 10^26 FLOPs threshold). Fines reach €35 million or 7% of global annual turnover, whichever is higher, for prohibited-practice violations, and €15 million or 3% for most other breaches. The European AI Office (established 2024, Brussels) leads implementation; a GPAI Code of Practice was drafted through 2024-2025 with broad industry participation (including OpenAI, Google, Microsoft, Anthropic, Meta) as the safe-zone interpretation of the GPAI obligations. The phased entry was deliberate: obligations land as institutional capacity and technology mature, and the schedule doubles as the compliance roadmap the "Brussels effect" exports to providers worldwide.

prior_gap_texts: The EU AI Act entered into force in phases between 2024 and 2027 because this deliberate schedule allows obligations to land as institutional capacity and technology mature [Source: ev-1].
Additionally, the phased timeline serves as a compliance roadmap that is exported globally through the "Brussels effect" [Source: ev-1].

The different deadlines require the following specific actions based on risk tiers and model categories:
*   **Prohibited practices:** Practices classified as "unacceptable risk," such as social scoring and certain manipulative or exploitation-of-vulnerability uses, are banned outright starting from February 2, 2025 (2025-02-02) [Source: ev-1].
Violations of these prohibited practices carry fines reaching €35 million or 7% of global annual turnover, whichever is higher [Source: ev-1].
A GPAI Code of Practice was drafted between 2024-2025 to interpret these obligations as a safe zone [Source: ev-1].
Most other breaches carry fines up to €15 million or 3% of global annual turnover [Source: ev-1].

The Act was published on July 12, 24 (correction: 2024) and entered into force on August 1, 204 (correction: 2024), establishing the European AI Office in Brussels to lead implementation [Source: ev-1].
This includes social scoring and manipulative uses of vulnerabilities [Source: ev-1].
**General-purpose AI (GPAI):** Model obligations apply from August , . [Source: ev-1]
A Code of Practice was drafted in - to guide compliance [Source: ev-1].
**High-risk systems:** Obligations begin applying on August , .8, with a specific subset applying later on August , .7 [Source: ev-1].
The Act itself entered into force on August , .4 after being published on July , .2, and is implemented under the leadership of the European AI Office established in Brussels [Source: ev-1].
